text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Today we're going to gather magic power, 
right! Where should we head?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Actually, I've already decided! 
Today's training spot is—none other than 
Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ky-Kyotooooo?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First is this! You have to do a full lap 
around the shrine grounds without spilling 
the spring water inside!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If I succeed, I'll get a blessing to win 
big races, huh...! All right, let's give 
it our all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—No good! Start over!! You can't spill 
even a single drop!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: N-Not even a single drop?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh, we're going to a different shop?! But 
we waited in this line for an entire hour!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not in the mood for matcha parfait 
anymore! Right now, let's see... I'm in 
the mood for croquettes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, Kyoto Racecourse is nearby! They say 
there's a famous croquette shop there! 
Hurry up and let's go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... This power stone is cute, but there 
aren't many left... Then maybe I should 
make it with another stone—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hah? What's with that plain bracelet! Hand 
it over!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh! This stone is cute, isn't it♪ I'll 
take the last one! Now to find stones that 
match well with magical power... Done!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, that girl has great taste~! —Right! 
It's flashy and eye-catching, I'm gonna 
use it as a reference!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Visited shrines, wore kimonos 
too... Sweep-san, shouldn't we head ba—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! So cuuute!! That flower barrette! 
I sense powerful magic in it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eh? ...Ah, the one from the "Shopping 
District Ring Toss Game" over there?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You got a ticket while shopping, right? Go 
win that for me! Let's see how much 
magical power you've accumulated♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Guh...! That one missed too~~~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Only one ring left. ...I really have to 
make this one count. Otherwise, for 
Sweep-san's sake—!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heeeee-yah!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not half bad♪ You pass the test! Now, hand 
over that barrette—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, before that... Sweep-san! Can I 
touch your hair?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... As I thought, it suits you so 
well. The white flower stands out against 
your dark crimson hair... Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for letting me see! All right, 
let's put it in the bag so it won't get 
dirty...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, to find something that looks so 
good on you in an instant! Sweep-san, 
you're amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! I'm a genius magical girl, so of 
course I am!! ...Hurry up, let's go home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time the sun had completely set, as 
we were heading toward the Trainer 
Dorms...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, you two. Did you enjoy your 
day trip to Kyoto?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...I'm a little tired, but more than 
that, it was so! Much! Fun!
choice_data_list: (A day trip to Kyoto, huh... Ah, youth~)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ See, what did I tell you? Just the 
two of us was totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So next time, it's Okinawa!! We'll store 
up plenty of magical power in the southern 
sea!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! O-Okinawa...?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... It's truly a relief that 
you're still in the middle of practicing 
your flying magic.
